context: A train platform on a quiet afternoon. Six-year-old Sho has dropped his train pass; a high school girl picks it up.
purpose: kindness micro-encounter — older girl gives a kid grace, both walk away brighter

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Already kneeling in the voice. Kansai cadence softened for a kid.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Tiny voice. Surprised to have an older girl talking to him.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 気をつけよ。電車、もうすぐ来るで。
lines.style: Big-sister tone, Kansai. Warm, brisk, useful.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。
lines.style: Full keigo from a six-year-old. A real little bow in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: (grins) You're a serious one. See ya.
lines.style: A real grin in the voice. Standing up. Affectionate.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: No words. The smallest hand-lift in the universe.
